name: pleejr
description: pleejr's Claude Code plugins: boundary-agnostic engineering skills grouped by family.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Reasoning and verification craft skills, plus shared output styles.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Terraform, access and credential judgment skills.

plugins.name: acronyms
plugins.description: Always-on acronym expansion mode with a UserPromptSubmit hook and a skip-list.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Herdr space naming and peer Claude Code sessions; resets the space name at session start.

plugins.name: credential-guard
plugins.description: Keeps credentials out of the session transcript and keeps them usable: redacts what it finds behind a placeholder, substitutes the real value back into a tool call, and offers the macOS login Keychain. Lives in its own repo.

plugins.name: machine-config
plugins.description: Snapshot, restore and verify a machine's Claude Code config through a git repo you control; autosaves at session end and applies shared output styles at session start.

plugins.name: plugin-updates
plugins.description: Session-start report of every installed plugin behind its marketplace's latest release, with an offer to update; works with any marketplace.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A status line under the prompt: model, directory, context bands, the 5h/7d subscription windows, a spinner while shell work runs, and an idle timer; wired by its own script.
